title: When Does Trace-Driven Evaluation Mislead MoE Expert Caching? Replay Semantics, Workload Contamination, and Operating Regimes
abstract: arXiv:2608.07911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have outgrown accelerator memory, and offloading expert weights to host memory is now standard. This makes expert cache management an attractive lever: a policy that raised the hit rate would cut expert traffic per token. Evaluating that is a measurement problem, and we find the measurement fragile.   With a trace-driven, event-atomic simulator over three MoE models (40, 64, 128 experts), we isolate three evaluation axes that change conclusions, not just numbers. Replay semantics: under a fused-event traffic contract, an inconsistent per-access replay inflates recency-based policies by 27-29% while leaving frequency-based and static ones within 4%, inverting the policy ranking. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07911v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：混合专家（MoE）模型已超出加速器内存容量，将专家权重卸载至主机内存现已成为标准做法。这使得专家缓存管理成为一个有吸引力的杠杆：提高命中率的策略将减少每个令牌的专家流量。评估这一问题属于测量问题，我们发现测量结果较为脆弱。通过一个基于轨迹、事件原子性的模拟器，在三个MoE模型（40、64、128个专家）上，我们隔离了三个会改变结论（而非仅数字）的评估轴。重放语义：在融合事件流量契约下，不一致的按访问重放会使基于近期性的策略膨胀27-29%，而基于频率和静态策略则保持在4%以内，从而反转策略排名。工作负载污染：使用每个类别一个指令模板的探针集会产生逐字相同的生成前缀；一种配对渲染干预将测量的早期窗口效应移动了19.4-31.9个百分点，并...
tldr: 本文揭示了基于轨迹的MoE专家缓存评估中的三个关键脆弱性——重放语义、工作负载污染和运行区间，它们能显著改变策略排名和结论，而非仅影响数值。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals three critical fragilities in trace-driven MoE expert caching evaluation—replay semantics, workload contamination, and operating regimes—which can significantly alter policy rankings and conclusions, not just numerical results.
